headline: Swiss National Bank President Schlegel Addresses Policy Rate Transmission
summary: Swiss National Bank Chairman Martin Schlegel delivered a address on the transmission of monetary policy, highlighting the SNB policy rate as the primary instrument for managing Switzerland's open economy.
why: The Swiss National Bank sets interest rates for the Swiss Franc, a key global reserve currency and safe haven asset.

impacts.name: Swiss Franc
impacts.why: Central bank communication reaffirms the current monetary framework for the open Swiss economy.
